faq.question: What does Mahathir mean?
faq.answer: Mahathir is associated with the Sanskrit form مَهَاتِير, whose core sense is mahathir; great arrow (malay).

faq.question: What is the origin of Mahathir?

faq.answer: Mahathir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Sanskrit-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
